why_it_moved.text: The effect held steady from the first days after exposure (+0.81%) to the last days (+0.80%), so it is not a novelty bump.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: Mechanism is unknown: the scorecard has no segment cuts, so we cannot say which queries the new ranker helps.

would_change: A pre-exposure comparison showing the two groups already differed on Successful Search Rate would make the test unreliable, because that check could not run.
A guardrail moving past its margin in a longer read or a post-release holdout would reverse the call.
